name: workbench
description: 个人工作台 - 可扩展的桌面工作台，功能以模块形式接入

scripts.tauri:restart: lsof -ti:1420 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; pkill -9 -f 'target/debug/workbench' 2>/dev/null; pkill -9 -f 'cargo run' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'MacOS/workbench' 2>/dev/null; while lsof -ti:1420 >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 0.5; done; tauri dev
scripts.tauri:ble: tauri build --debug --bundles app && (pkill -f 'MacOS/workbench' || true) && sleep 1 && open "$PWD/src-tauri/target/debug/bundle/macos/个人工作台.app"
scripts.app:install: pkill -f 'MacOS/workbench'; sleep 1; ditto "$PWD/src-tauri/target/debug/bundle/macos/个人工作台.app" "/Applications/个人工作台.app" && open "/Applications/个人工作台.app"
